reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: getDailyAttendanceDetails has an active caller (OverallAttendanceCalendar.tsx:43) and is exported (Gate 1); the entry point is an authenticated HTTP request from an untrusted user — no trust_assumptions entry elevates it (Gate 2); src/app/actions.ts and src/app/dashboard/ are both in-scope (Gate 3). An attacker can trigger this via /dashboard/overall by navigating to the route as any authenticated (non-admin) member, causing getDailyAttendanceDetails to return all members' cross-user attendance details (by team and grade) because the function uses createSupabaseAdminClient() with no is_admin guard. HIGH severity is appropriate given the direct PII/cross-user data disclosure impact explicitly listed in key_security_concerns.
